scientific_integrity: Exact universal finite-dimensional proof is included; computations are supporting checks only. Scholarly priority has not undergone independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-disk result concerns complex 2-by-2 matrices in Frobenius norm.
Real minimizer assertion requires real input and real target center.
Larger sizes, spectral-norm minimization and floating-point backward stability are not established.
A previous equivalent result under nilpotent-orbit or field-of-values terminology remains a residual historical-priority possibility.
title: Exact Frobenius projection onto prescribed circular numerical ranges of \(2\times2\) matrices
